policy.dimensions: Height and width are transcribed only from Clark catalog physical descriptions.
policy.depth: Every d value is an interface estimate from Clark-stated extent using catalog-extent-model-v1; it is not a measurement of the Clark copy.
policy.covers: Cover images and provider-edition geometry are not inputs to this index.
policy.full_provenance: Load book_profiles.json#{id} only when a full physical-evidence view is opened.

shared_warnings.message: Shelf geometry is a metadata-derived representation, not a photograph or measurement of Clark's copy.

fields.h: Clark-stated height cm: scalar when exact, otherwise [midpoint, minimum, maximum].
fields.w: Clark-stated front width cm: scalar when exact, otherwise [midpoint, minimum, maximum].
fields.d: Modeled depth cm: [midpoint, minimum, maximum, Clark-stated page-equivalent basis].
fields.f: 1 when h/w are the Clark-stated folded presentation dimensions.
fields.o: Object-form code from object_form_codes; unknown is explicit.
fields.q: Record warning bitset from warning_bits; decoded warnings are mandatory.
